messages:
emma: Heads-up — customer ACME hit a spike of 500s and very high tail latency on hosted inference around 09:30 UTC. They gave a big app bundle. We need a tiny repro + exact steps to collect request IDs, headers, and a debug bundle. Can someone draft minimal curl/py/js/go snippets and a checklist for the customer?

jason: I can take the initial checklist. Priority items: 1) exact root request timestamps (UTC), 2) any X-Request-ID or request-id headers returned, 3) SDK debug logs (level=debug), 4) small reproducer that triggers the issue (single-file).

maria: I'll add SDK snippets — keep them as tiny as possible. Also ask them to run with RW_SDK_LOG=debug (env) so our SDK emits request IDs. Example curl (minimal):

```bash
# minimal curl reproducer (attach -v output)
export RW_API_KEY=REDACTED
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hi there"}' \
  https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 2>&1 | tee curl-output.txt
```

maria: Capture the response headers (look for `X-Request-Id` / `x-request-id`) and include the full `curl-output.txt`. If there is a stream, please run the non-streaming call first to make logs easier.

maria: Python minimal (requests):

```python
# tiny repro: python3 repro.py
import os
import requests

KEY = os.getenv('RW_API_KEY')
url = 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate'
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {KEY}', 'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
json = {'model':'gpt-4o-mini','input':'hello'}
resp = requests.post(url, headers=headers, json=json, timeout=15)
print('status', resp.status_code)
print('resp headers:', dict(resp.headers))
print('body:', resp.text)
```

maria: JS minimal (node fetch):

```js
// node repro.js
const fetch = require('node-fetch')
const url = 'https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate'
;(async ()=>{
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Authorization': `Bearer ${process.env.RW_API_KEY}`, 'Content-Type':'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', input: 'hello' }),
    timeout: 15000
  })
  console.log('status', res.status)
  console.log('headers', Object.fromEntries(res.headers))
  console.log('body', await res.text())
})()
```

maria: Go minimal (net/http):

```go
// go run repro.go
package main
import (
  "bytes"
  "fmt"
  "io/ioutil"
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main(){
  key := os.Getenv("RW_API_KEY")
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST","https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate", bytes.NewBufferString(`{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}`))
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)
  req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
  client := &http.Client{}
  resp, err := client.Do(req)
  if err!=nil{fmt.Println("err",err); return}
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b,_ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  fmt.Println("status", resp.StatusCode)
  fmt.Println("headers", resp.Header)
  fmt.Println("body", string(b))
}
```

jason: Good. Also ask them to reproduce with a token-limited small loop to hit the error more reliably, e.g.:

```bash
for i in {1..10}; do 
  curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"test '$i'"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate &
done
wait
```

jason: Capture the peak `time_total` values and include the curl outputs. If they can, run the same loop with `RW_SDK_LOG=debug` or `RW_SDK_TRACE=1` (SDK env var) so we get client-side timings and request IDs.

oliver: For our side, ask them to include the following when they reply:
- root UTC minute range (e.g., 2026-03-17T09:30:00Z -> 2026-03-17T09:36:00Z)
- at least one `X-Request-Id` header from a failing request (exact value)
- the `curl-output.txt` and SDK debug log
- whether they were using streaming or non-streaming call

oliver: If they can't find X-Request-Id in the response, instruct them to add an explicit header on the client side so we can correlate server logs, e.g.:

```bash
curl -v -H "X-Client-Request-Id: $RANDOM-$USER" -H "Authorization: Bearer $RW_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4o-mini","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate 2>&1 | tee curl-output.txt
```

priya: Support-bot has a debug bundle helper — once they attach `curl-output.txt` and `sdk-debug.log`, we can run: `@support-bot create-debug-bundle --channel support --req-ids 01ABC... --range 09:30-09:36`. Please include exact `X-Request-Id` values.

support-bot: To create a debug bundle run
`@support-bot create-debug-bundle --req-ids <comma-separated-ids> --start <UTC> --end <UTC>`

support-bot: Example: `@support-bot create-debug-bundle --req-ids 01F2Z3ABCD --start 2026-03-17T09:30:00Z --end 2026-03-17T09:36:00Z`

emma: I'll send this checklist to ACME and ask them to run the snippets and attach `curl-output.txt` + `sdk-debug.log`. I'll also ask for their region and whether they were using Redwood Dedicated or Hosted.

priya: I'll monitor logs once they send the request IDs. If they provide >1 failing req_id, attach them all.

maria: One more note: if they're using long streaming sessions, ask them to toggle to non-streaming for repro (servers handle streaming differently). Many intermittent 500s we've seen go away on the non-streaming path.

emma: Thanks team — I'll post back here with the files from the customer. :thumbsup:
